description.text: The major pays attention to the cultivation of students with generous solid mathematical theory foundation, basic knowledge of applied mathematics and the ability to solve practical problems, and a skilled computer operating capacity and the ability to use network resources, so that students have the sense of innovation in mathematics or Applied Mathematics in a certain direction of contemporary academic research. Graduates should be qualified for such jobs as research, teaching or practical application, research and development management in the production sectors or management departments, in the field of science and technology, education, the economy and enterprises. Graduates are featured with a solid foundation for the mathematical theory, a skilled computer operating capacity, and capability of software applications, software development and management.

duration.text: The Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
